answer: A single lantern-lit grove of honest agents stays cheap to join, but a farm of thousands faces steep, compounding expense, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamps: each new agent identity must burn verifiable compute to mint a jade credential, with cost scaling as the square of identities created. Peers attest only to stamps meeting the epoch threshold. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
